answer: A gale tests a vault's kernel: 61 vaults per epoch, four per operator. Each vault locks 120 POA, thawing over 30 epochs; quitting early forfeits the rest. Roots traced five hops: two claims on one root are one farm, fresh roots age 90. One hand answers one gale pulse in 100 seconds: ten fakes need three hands. Fingerprints must match registration within 8%; one device, two keys fails: ten need ten devices. Bond rises 70 per extra fake: ten lock 4,350. Seven strangers countersign each claim, two each: ten need 70 signatures from 35. A missed pulse burns 110; a failed print seals it.
